    // The unsigned distance from a point to the quadrilateral patch with the given
    // vertices in ring order. Exact for a planar quad. For a non-planar one the
    // plane branch measures against the plane through A, B and D, which the fourth
    // corner has left — that is NOT a bound, so prefer the two triangles of the
    // patch's triangulation when the corners are not coplanar. (IQ: udQuad.)
    UnsignedDistanceToQuad(p: Point3D, a: Point3D, b: Point3D, c: Point3D, d: Point3D): Number {
        var ba = a.Between(b);
        var cb = b.Between(c);
        var dc = c.Between(d);
        var ad = d.Between(a);
        var pa = a.Between(p);
        var pb = b.Between(p);
        var pc = c.Between(p);
        var pd = d.Between(p);
        var normal = ba.Cross(ad);
        var insideVotes = ba.Cross(normal).Dot(pa).Sign
                        + cb.Cross(normal).Dot(pb).Sign
                        + dc.Cross(normal).Dot(pc).Sign
                        + ad.Cross(normal).Dot(pd).Sign;
        var toEdges = EdgeOffset(ba, pa).LengthSquared
            .Min(EdgeOffset(cb, pb).LengthSquared)
            .Min(EdgeOffset(dc, pc).LengthSquared)
            .Min(EdgeOffset(ad, pd).LengthSquared);
        var toPlane = normal.Dot(pa) * normal.Dot(pa) / normal.LengthSquared;
        return (insideVotes < 3 ? toEdges : toPlane).Sqrt;
    }
